Zone B · stack position

The Eight Faces of Te

The canvas draws Te as a scaffold: structure raised in public, tested by results. Where Te sits in a person's stack — the fixed order their eight functions come in — changes how it builds. Click a position to see the change, and watch the throughput counter: it tells the story before the caption does. Drag the maturity slider to watch the lower seats gain fidelity with age.

Zone C · feeder coupling

What Feeds Into Te?

Te judges; it does not gather. Introverted judging is fed by extraverted perception, and extraverted judging by introverted perception — so Te's real partners are Ni and Si. Click a feeder to watch what it builds.

Zone D · verification lab

The Verification Lab

Ti verifies against its own coherence. Te verifies against results: build the thing, measure what comes back, keep or cut accordingly. Each button sends a different kind of feedback into the lab.

Click an event to send Te feedback, and watch what the scaffold does when the numbers come back — and with material that has no number at all.
